title.name: IRON NOMAD
title.tag: Two scavengers. Two scrap mopeds. One broadcast from the north.
radio.intro1: ...Haven holds. Clean water, walls, a gate that opens. Follow the north road...
radio.intro2: ...Haven holds. Follow the north road. Bring what you can carry...
radio.l1.end: ...the gate opens for those who come in peace. Repeat. The gate opens...
radio.l2.start: ...new coordinates. Haven has moved. Do not use the old road. Repeat, do not...
radio.l2.voice2: A second voice cuts in: "Whoever you are, don't answer the signal. Just drive."
radio.l3.start: ...Haven holds. Haven holds. Haven holds. Haven holds...
radio.fragment: Radio fragment recovered ({n}/4). The static resolves for a second into something that sounds like a name.
radio.fragment.dup: Another fragment of the broadcast. Same loop, different gaps.
radio.dusk: The Dusk Bell rings. Find a camp before the sun goes.
radio.night: Night is on the road. Engines carry twice as far in the dark.
radio.stranded: Your partner is too far behind. Regroup!
radio.mechanic.fix: Mechanic: "Hold still, I'll patch her up."
radio.mechanic.cover: Mechanic: "Can't work with rounds coming in!"
radio.crew.warn1: {name}: "Pay me what I'm owed, or I'm done riding with you."
radio.crew.warn2: {name}: "One more missed meal and I walk. Last warning."
radio.crew.refuse: {name}: "No. Find someone else to take that order."
radio.crew.desert: {name} has deserted the convoy in the night, with a vehicle and a share of supplies.
radio.horde: The shrieking has woken the whole block. Horde incoming!
radio.fuelLow: Fuel is low. Pour a can before you stall.
radio.legDone: End of the road for today. Pick a place to make camp.
tip.drive: Drive north along the road. Fuel is shared between you both. Keep within 300 m of your partner.
tip.dust: Dust is Signature: faster means a longer plume. Raiders read it from far away.
tip.ambush: Raiders! Outturn the buggies. Hold Y to bail, A to handbrake, X to blow the horn.
tip.city: Cities listen. Engines are Noise. Park, dismount and thread the alleys quietly.
tip.fuel: Low fuel: get out (Y), swap to the jerrycan (LB), then hold A at your vehicle to pour.
tip.repair: Damaged? Swap to the wrench and hold A at your vehicle. A partner's covering fire is the plan.
tip.loot: Hold A at containers to search. Searching is loud. Deeper shelves are better and louder.
tip.camp: Place defenses with RT. Park vehicles in the perimeter. Watch posts give early warning.
enc.vote: Vote in your own half. If you disagree, the Encounter Lead decides. Overriding your partner costs 1 Trust.
enc.stranded_family.title: A Family by the Road
enc.stranded_family.text: A rusted hatchback is stuck in the sand. A man waves a dry jerrycan. Two kids watch from the back seat. Their water is almost gone.
enc.stranded_family.help.result: They drive off north, waving. The man says he'll tell people about the convoy that stopped.
enc.stranded_family.rob.result: You leave them on foot. The kids stop waving long before you're out of sight.
enc.stranded_family.leave.result: You keep your eyes on the road.
enc.wounded_raider.title: Wounded Raider
enc.wounded_raider.text: A raider lies against a burned-out buggy, gut-shot, rifle out of reach. She's still breathing. The flag on the wreck is red-orange.
enc.wounded_raider.patch.result: She tells you where the next ambush is set. It's not much, but it's honest.
enc.wounded_raider.strip.result: You take what is useful and leave her the shade.
enc.wounded_raider.finish.result: Quiet. Efficient. The crew doesn't look at you for a while.
enc.toll_road.title: The Toll
enc.toll_road.text: A chain across the road. A raider with a clipboard (a real clipboard) wants 15 Scrap each to pass. Two buggies idle behind him.
enc.toll_road.pay.result: He tears off a receipt. It says PAID. It might even be honored.
enc.toll_road.fight.result: The chain snaps. The buggies don't stay idle.
enc.toll_road.bluff: Bluff: a bigger convoy is behind you
enc.toll_road.bluff.result: He squints at the empty road behind you.
enc.radio_tower.title: The Tower
enc.radio_tower.text: A radio mast stands alone on a ridge. The antenna still hums. Something at the base is scratching at the door.
enc.radio_tower.climb: Climb it and pull the board
enc.radio_tower.climb.result: The board is warm. In the static you catch a name you recognise, then the dead start climbing.
enc.buried_cache.title: Buried Cache
enc.buried_cache.text: A cairn of white stones with a spade stuck in it. Someone buried this for later and never came back.
enc.buried_cache.dig.result: Fuel, scrap, parts. Whoever buried it was planning for a long walk.
enc.buried_cache.mark.result: You leave it for whoever comes back.
enc.dying_trader.title: Last Sale
enc.dying_trader.text: A trader leans on his overloaded cart, grey-faced. "Take it all," he says, "but I'd rather you paid."
enc.dying_trader.buy.result: He counts the scrap twice, then smiles and closes his eyes.
enc.dying_trader.comfort: Share a ration and sit with him
enc.dying_trader.comfort.result: He presses a few parts into your hand. "For the road," he says.
enc.orphan_cart.title: The Cart
enc.orphan_cart.text: A child pulls a wagon of dolls and water cans along the shoulder, heading north. She says Haven is that way. She's right.
enc.orphan_cart.share: Share rations and a ride's worth of fuel
enc.orphan_cart.share.result: She gives you a doll. You pretend not to be touched.
enc.orphan_cart.direct.result: She nods and keeps pulling the cart.
enc.orphan_cart.ignore.result: The mirror shows her getting smaller.
enc.pharmacy_looters.title: Counter Service
enc.pharmacy_looters.text: Five scavengers have set up in the pharmacy's lobby with a hand-painted sign. They haven't noticed the shuffling in the street behind you yet.
enc.pharmacy_looters.negotiate.result: A tense handshake, a promise to stay out of each other's way.
enc.pharmacy_looters.drive_off.result: They scatter. The noise you made does not.
enc.survivors_cellar.title: Voices Below
enc.survivors_cellar.text: Knocking from a cellar door welded shut from the outside. Someone is alive in there. Someone also welded it.
enc.survivors_cellar.rescue.result: Four people climb out blinking. The torch noise brought company.
enc.survivors_cellar.supplies: Take the supplies stacked outside the door
enc.survivors_cellar.supplies.result: The knocking stops when you leave.
enc.survivors_cellar.ignore.result: You don't wonder who welded it. Much.
enc.wreck_salvage.title: The Convoy That Was
enc.wreck_salvage.text: Half a convoy, burned and picked clean: a truck, two cars and a handful of graves. The truck still has a good axle.
enc.wreck_salvage.strip.result: Efficient. You leave the graves alone, at least.
enc.wreck_salvage.grave: Take only the axle; fix the grave markers
enc.wreck_salvage.grave.result: It takes ten minutes. You don't talk about why.
enc.lost_courier.title: The Courier
enc.lost_courier.text: A woman with a satchel flags you down. She carries messages for the north. She says she has heard the broadcast changing too, and she has pieces of it on a tape.
enc.lost_courier.escort.result: She presses the tape into your hand. "Listen to it backwards," she says.
enc.lost_courier.directions.result: She thanks you and heads off alone.
enc.lost_courier.rob.result: The tape is gone, but the satchel is heavy.
end.openGate.title: The Open Gate
end.openGate.text: Haven opens to the whole convoy. The broadcast was a call for escorts; your convoy becomes Haven's road patrol.
end.toll.title: The Toll
end.toll.text: Haven demands the vehicles and crew as tribute. You choose: surrender, fight the gate, or turn away.
end.twoWalked.title: Two Walked In
end.twoWalked.text: Only two survivors reach the gate, on foot. Quiet and bittersweet.
end.warlord.title: Warlord's Road
end.warlord.text: The convoy takes Haven by force and rules it.
end.hollow.title: Hollow Haven
end.hollow.text: The broadcast is an automated loop. Haven's people are long gone. The convoy decides whether to rebuild it.
lean.openGate: Mercy is building: the road is warming to you.
lean.toll: Your name travels ahead of you. Haven may ask for a price.
lean.twoWalked: The convoy is thinning out. Trust is running thin.
lean.warlord: Fear is your currency. It spends well, and it is running up a debt.
lean.neutral: The road hasn't made up its mind about you yet.
camp.dispute.pay.text: {name} wants a raise: 5 more points of the loot cut, or they walk.
camp.dispute.cowardice.text: {name} refused an order and is being told off by everybody who listened.
